Recorded claim:
A historical review of D329733 reported that, when no tags existed, a Keywords Contains menu had no selected item but the editor reported a successful save with zero search terms. Check for a selected tag before saving this filter type. The review said its test restored the tags. Recheck the current revision before treating this finding as present.
